result.summary: This PR adds `-D_GLIBCXX_USE_DEPRECATED=0` to the CFLAGS used in all four Guix build scripts (linux, linux-gui, win, win-gui), disabling libstdc++'s deprecated compatibility symbols to save a small amount of debug-symbol size. It also exports the Guix time-machine URL/commit as environment variables in prelude.bash for reuse. The PR is stacked on and shares commits with #36082 (adding Guix builds to CI), which is still open.
result.problem: Guix release builds currently include unnecessary deprecated libstdc++ symbols in debug info, which is a minor inefficiency the author wants to trim; this doesn't fix a bug or block anyone.
